svg.title: Load Balancing
svg.desc: Load Balancing. Spread requests across healthy instances and stop sending to unhealthy ones. Step 1, Spread the requests: Round robin deals requests to A, B and C in turn. Clients see one address, never an instance. Step 2, Pick the least busy: Slow requests pile up on B. Least connections sends each new request to the fewest in flight. Step 3, Skip unhealthy instances: C stops answering /healthz. After 3 failed probes it is marked unhealthy and gets no new requests. Step 4, Recover and rejoin: C is fixed and passes 2 probes in a row, so it rejoins. Slow start ramps its share up gradually.

g.text: Round robin deals requests to A, B and C in turn. Clients see one address, never an instance.
Slow requests pile up on B. Least connections sends each new request to the fewest in flight.
C stops answering /healthz. After 3 failed probes it is marked unhealthy and gets no new requests.
C is fixed and passes 2 probes in a row, so it rejoins. Slow start ramps its share up gradually.
Health check · GET /healthz every few seconds · example values
3 fails in a row → unhealthy · 2 passes in a row → healthy
